en: Air has mass and takes up space, which is why a basketball feels heavier and harder when it is fully inflated.
Melting uses heat to change a solid into a liquid, whereas dissolving mixes a solid into a liquid to form a solution.
Evaporation happens at any temperature when surface water molecules gain energy to become gas, unlike boiling which only occurs at 100 degrees Celsius.
Rusting is a chemical change because iron reacts with oxygen and moisture to form iron oxide, a completely new substance.
Dissolved sugar does not disappear because its molecules simply spread evenly throughout the water, keeping the solution sweet even if the crystals are invisible.
The total mass of a substance stays exactly the same when it changes state, like when solid ice melts into liquid water.
Objects float or sink based on their density compared to water, not just their weight, which is why a massive steel ship floats.
Burning wood is a chemical change because it produces new substances like ash and carbon dioxide gas that cannot be reversed back into wood.
Not all metals are magnetic because common metals like aluminum cans, copper wires, and gold jewelry are not attracted to magnets.
Boiling occurs throughout an entire liquid at a specific boiling point, while evaporation only happens at the liquid's surface at any temperature.
While solid mixtures like pebbles and sand can be separated by hand, dissolved mixtures like saltwater require evaporation to separate the components.
Even though gases are invisible, they are made of moving particles that take up space and exert pressure inside a closed container.
